summary: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited third-quarter 2026 results (quarter ended September 30, 2026), the routine quarterly earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer rather than a special-situation event. Total revenues rose Ps. 2,091.2 million, or 21.8%, and EBITDA increased 19.2% to Ps. 6,064.6 million, with the EBITDA margin at 67.8%. Results consolidate Cross Border Xpress from the May 1, 2026 business combination approved at the December 11, 2025 shareholders' meeting; purchase accounting remains preliminary. Passenger traffic fell 1.4%. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated.
